{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Plasma glucose concentration normalized to training set mean and std, providing a standardized continuous score centered at zero for linear margin separation",
      "value_range": [-3.85, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly normalized glucose is the strongest single predictor; standardization improves SVM margin geometry",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 120.026) / 31.199"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Body mass index normalized to training set mean and std, capturing obesity severity as a smooth continuous score",
      "value_range": [-4.23, 2.51],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized BMI improves linear separability for obesity-related metabolic risk",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.173) / 7.366"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age normalized to training set mean and std, providing a smooth continuous age risk score",
      "value_range": [-1.03, 3.47],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized age contributes linearly to SVM margin for age-related metabolic risk",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 32.693) / 11.320"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of normalized glucose and BMI scores, combining two strong metabolic risk indicators into a single linear projection",
      "value_range": [-5.5, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of top two predictors approximates a useful projection direction for SVM hyperplane",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.6 * ((plas - 120.026) / 31.199) + 0.4 * ((mass - 31.173) / 7.366)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed insulin level normalized by training mean of log-insulin, reducing right skew for smoother linear feature",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log transformation reduces insulin skewness, improving linear SVM performance on this highly skewed feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(insu) - 3.178) / 1.612"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedigree_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed diabetes pedigree function normalized to reduce skew, capturing genetic risk as a smooth continuous score",
      "value_range": [-2.8, 2.8],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized pedigree score provides smooth genetic risk signal for linear margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(pedi) - 0.358) / 0.212"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_age_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of normalized glucose and normalized age, capturing the interaction between high glucose and older age as a metabolic risk amplifier",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 8.7],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Interaction term approximates a nonlinear boundary in linear SVM feature space, capturing joint risk elevation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((plas - 120.026) / 31.199) * ((age - 32.693) / 11.320)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pregnancies_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of pregnancies normalized to training mean and std, capturing reproductive history as a continuous risk score",
      "value_range": [-1.16, 2.97],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized pregnancy count contributes to linear margin for parity-related metabolic risk",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(preg - 3.641) / 3.151"
    },
    {
      "name": "skin_thickness_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Triceps skin fold thickness normalized to training mean and std, capturing adiposity as a continuous score",
      "value_range": [-1.21, 2.49],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized skin thickness provides smooth adiposity signal complementary to BMI for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(skin - 19.536) / 16.222"
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_pressure_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of diastolic blood pressure from training mean, normalized by std, capturing hypertension severity as a non-negative continuous score",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.95],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Blood pressure deviation from normal captures hypertension risk in a smooth, non-negative form useful for linear margins",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs((pres - 67.908) / 18.309)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_risk_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of normalized glucose, BMI, age, and pedigree scores representing overall metabolic risk as a single continuous projection",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Multi-factor composite approximates the dominant linear discriminant direction, providing a strong single feature for SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.35 * ((plas - 120.026) / 31.199) + 0.25 * ((mass - 31.173) / 7.366) + 0.20 * ((age - 32.693) / 11.320) + 0.20 * ((np.log1p(pedi) - 0.358) / 0.212)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_ratio_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of insulin-to-glucose ratio balance on a continuous scale from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate more physiologically balanced insulin response relative to glucose level. Score accounts for zero insulin values (missing data pattern) and extreme ratios indicating insulin resistance or deficiency.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures insulin resistance signal as a smooth normalized score, providing a physiologically meaningful feature for linear SVM that raw ratio cannot due to zero-inflation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
